notes.markdown:
Export jobs to your own storage, Ask your PBX, proactive health warnings, push-to-talk channels, an AI call
assistant, contact-center skills, quality reviews and surveys, reseller partners, eSIMs in MonoPhone and the console,
on-device AI and a refreshed look in MonoPhone, and many fixes.

## New

- **Export jobs.** Admin, Connections, Export jobs: copy recordings, voicemail, call history, team chat with its
  files, transcripts with AI summaries, SMS and channel messages, the audit log, faxes and reports to one of your
  storage destinations, once or on a schedule. Choose the folder and file names from templates, audio as WAV or Ogg
  Opus, tables as CSV, JSONL or Parquet, optionally compressed. Every file is checked after upload and each run leaves
  a manifest of what it wrote. Install-wide jobs are under Admin, System, Backups.
- **Call the customer of a delivery order.** In the inbox, Call customer on a delivery conversation calls the customer
  through the PBX, in the console and in MonoPhone.

- **Ask your PBX.** Contact center, Ask your PBX: ask about your calls in plain language and get the answer as numbers
  and a chart, with the question that ran shown. Save questions, pin them to the dashboard and have them mailed on a
  schedule. Department supervisors see only their own departments. Uses your company's own AI model.
- **Proactive health.** Logs, Health: early warnings for trunks that degrade or keep losing registration, disks
  filling fast, late backups and drops in call quality, each with what to do and one-click fixes where possible. The
  dashboard shows the three most important items; system administrators get an install-wide report.
- **Push-to-talk channels.** Channels for a list of people, a department or a team chat group, with talker, listener
  and supervisor roles, one speaker at a time, a talk limit, supervisor take-over and optional recordings. Members'
  phones are woken when someone talks. Talking from MonoPhone comes with the app update that supports it.
- **Push-to-talk voice notes in chat.** A finished push-to-talk message can be kept as a voice note in the channel's
  chat group, marked with the channel and time. Chat recordings show a live waveform while you record, and you can pick
  a place on the map to share.
- **AI call assistant.** When you do not answer within the set time, the assistant can take the call, ask the caller
  who they are and why they call, and then put them through with a whisper, take a voicemail, transfer to a colleague
  or block the call. VIPs, colleagues and your own devices skip it; an executive's human assistant is tried first. It
  is also a step in call flows. It follows the caller into nine languages, the disclosure line is optional, and Admin,
  AI, Usage shows the estimated cost per day.
- **Agent skills.** Calls and routing, Agent skills: named skills with levels per agent and skill requirements per
  queue, with a coverage report. Agents without a required skill are not rung.
- **Quality reviews.** Score calls by hand with the same scorecard as the AI, compare manual and AI scores per agent
  and week, run calibration sessions, and let agents read and acknowledge their own reviews.
- **Post-call surveys.** Calls and routing, Post-call surveys: send a short satisfaction or recommendation survey by
  text message after a queue call, answered on a simple page without sign-in. Results per survey, queue and agent, and
  alerts on low scores.
- **Wallboard and kiosk widgets.** Kiosk widgets with their own queues and service-level thresholds, and per-user
  widgets and team queues on the wallboard.
- **Reseller partners.** Admin, System, Companies, Partners: partners with their own portal to create and manage their
  companies within a seat allocation, with branding, a usage report and support access that the company approves,
  declines or revokes on its Support access page.
- **Company templates.** Admin, System, Companies, Templates: create a company, its first administrator and its whole
  starting setup from a versioned template in one step.
- **eSIMs for users.** MonoPhone Settings, My eSIMs and the console's My eSIMs show the eSIMs on your own extensions
  with the data left, and install one on the phone, by QR code or by activation code. Administrators assign eSIMs to
  users, send install links, issue them again or revoke them on the new eSIM assignments page.
- **Automation triggers and limits.** Automations can start from a live call trigger, from their own web address
  (webhook) or on a schedule, and can be run now by hand. Each company has limits on runs, and administrators are
  alerted when one is reached.
- **On-device AI in MonoPhone.** On supported iPhones and Android phones: summaries, suggested replies and Show in my
  language, with no text leaving the phone and no AI cost on the server.
- **Liquid Glass look in MonoPhone.** A floating glass tab bar and sheets on the newest iOS and macOS, a classic
  translucent bar on older iOS, an opaque version with Reduce Transparency, and a Material 3 look on Android.
- **Android contacts, files and watch.** Colleagues can appear in Android Contacts (Settings, off by default).
  Recordings, voicemail and chat files can be saved to Files. Wear OS shows presence and unread chats with quick
  replies, and an On a call widget is available on Android.
- **Company blocklist in MonoPhone.** Settings, Admin, Blocklist: view, add, change and remove the company's blocked
  numbers and prefixes from the phone.
- **Voice one-time codes and translation defaults.** One-time codes can be sent by a voice call that reads the code.
  AI, AI agents, Live translation sets default caller and agent languages per queue, optionally from the caller's
  country, and can speak the agent's translated sentences into the call. Transcripts can be read translated into your
  language.
## Improved

- **Inbox attachments.** The console and MonoPhone say what each channel can send as a file, send other kinds as a
  link, and hide the file button where a channel takes neither. Videos in the MonoPhone inbox play full screen.
- **Jira issues from chat.** An issue created from a chat gets an AI summary when call summaries are switched on.
- **Console navigation.** Admin settings pages are gathered in one Settings area grouped by category (Company,
  Telephony, Users and security, Integrations, AI, Storage and compliance, System), with an All settings overview. A
  menu entry with sub-items now only folds and unfolds; its page is the first sub-item. Every page keeps its address.
- **Notifications in MonoPhone.** Chat and SMS notifications can show the start of the message when your company
  allows it. Missed calls offer Call back and Message, are grouped, and call notifications show the number and a short
  Call ended note.
- **Call screen.** Transfer and Move to another device are under a More button on the MonoPhone call screen, next to
  Record, Captions and Park. When a call cannot use them they are greyed out with the reason.
- **Sign-in.** In MonoPhone and the console, passkey and single sign-on are under More sign-in options below the main
  Sign in, shown only when the PBX offers them, and the last method you used is remembered.
- **Chat in the console.** Photos or initials everywhere in chat, a compact conversation header with Call and a menu,
  and Shared shown only when there is something shared. The quiet-hours time zone is a searchable list.
- **Chat in MonoPhone.** A lean header with only Call and a menu; tap the photo or name for the person's or group's
  details. Photos that failed to load are tried again, and groups show their picture in the lists.
- **Create Jira issue.** In the inbox, call details and voicemail details, in MonoPhone and the console, the button
  shows only when Jira is connected and you may create issues.
- **Settings in the console.** Settings has five tabs: Profile (where you can now change your photo), Calls and
  devices, Notifications, Privacy and security, and Language and display. Old addresses still work.
- **Test connection.** Test on an installed integration now checks an integration in four steps (settings, reachability, read
  access and AI tools) and gives a hint to fix each failure.
- **AI knowledge and receptionist.** Knowledge-base limits are company settings, shown with the current use. A website
  can be crawled again on demand with a list of what changed. Call history shows a quality panel, and a compliance miss
  can raise an alert.
- **Hand-over summary.** The web phone and MonoPhone show the AI agent's hand-over note on a ringing and an answered
  call.
- **Admin alerts on phones.** Tapping an admin or role alert in MonoPhone opens the matching alert page. Recents shows
  contact names, and chat forwards keep their images.
- **API changes: new endpoints.** Ask your PBX, health reports, push-to-talk channels, agent skills, quality
  reviews, post-call surveys, reseller partners and support access, company templates, eSIM assignments and installs,
  automation quotas, webhooks and run now, AI knowledge limits, translation defaults per queue, receptionist re-crawl
  and translated transcripts.
- **API changes: existing endpoints.** Test connection answers also list the steps. Chat messages carry an optional
  `ptt` field for push-to-talk voice notes. New chat messages accept `null` for optional fields. All changes are
  additive; new error codes are listed on the error code pages of the documentation.

## Fixed

- Sending a location in MonoPhone chat failed with a message about file types; it is sent again, and each failed send
  now says what went wrong for a photo, file, voice note or location. Chat sheets stay above the keyboard.
- A MonoPhone setup link stopped working without a reason after the device it was for was removed (for example by
  signing out of the app). The setup page now says why a link stopped working and what to do.
- MonoPhone Settings, Executive and assistant showed only Could not load on a PBX without that feature. It now says
  when the PBX needs an update, shows a friendly message when you are neither, and shows the real error otherwise.
- Admin and supervisor recordings downloaded but did not play in MonoPhone; they now play, whatever the audio format.
- Admin and role alert notifications did not reach phones and browsers; they arrive again.
